Questions , Answers.

What is Usage Buddy?

A desktop app for Windows 10 and 11 that monitors usage limits and reset times across multiple coding agent accounts.

Which coding agents are supported?

Usage Buddy currently supports OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.

Can I track more than one account?

Yes. Add multiple accounts for each provider, name them Personal or Work, and see each one separately. In short connect unlimited accounts

Does usage update automatically?

Yes. Choose a 5, 15, or 30 minute refresh interval, or refresh manually at any time.

Which Windows versions are supported?

Usage Buddy runs on 64-bit Windows 10 (version 1809 or newer) and Windows 11. Windows 8.1 and earlier are not supported.

Where is my data stored?

Your account credentials and usage data stay locally on your PC. Usage Buddy does not send them to our servers.

Is it available on Mac or Linux?

Not yet. Usage Buddy currently supports Windows only.
